This petition has been filed for direction directing the second respondent herein to release the entire amount kept in hold in favour of the respondent herein within the time frame to be stipulated by this Court.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials placed before this Court.
3.

The petitioners are the accused in C.C.No.7 of 2014 on the file of the learned Special Judge,
Special Court for TNPID Act cases, Coimbatore, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406,
120B r/w 420 of IPC.

entities.text:
Special Judge,
Special Court for TNPID Act cases, Coimbatore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Though the petitioners convicted by the trial Court, this Court by an order dated 04.06.2024 in Crl.A.No1321 of 2022, allowed the appeal and acquitted the petitioners from all charges.

In the meanwhile, some of the properties belonging to the petitioners were attached and sold out in the public auction and the sale proceeds were deposited with the second respondent to the tune of Rs.5,55,550/-.

In pursuant to the acquittal of the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 12/03/2025 01:26:30 pm ) petitioners from all the charges, attachment was raised and therefore, the petitioners submitted representation seeking refund of the amount.
4. Considering the above facts and circumstances, the second respondent is directed to return the money, which is lying in the second respondent towards sale consideration by auctioning the properties belonged to the petitioners, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
5. With the above directions, the Writ Petition stands allowed.
There shall
be no order as to costs.
